yarrow.step2: Set aside one stalk, symbolizing the Taiji
yarrow.step3: Divide 49 stalks into two groups randomly
yarrow.step4: Take one stalk from the left group and hold between fingers
yarrow.step5: Count the left group in sets of four
yarrow.step6: Count the right group in sets of four
